article.headline: Antonelli Wins US Grand Prix From Pole by 13 Seconds — Title One Race Away in Mexico

research.facts:
Antonelli Wins USGP
**Verified Facts (HIGH):**
- Kimi Antonelli (Mercedes) won the 2026 US Grand Prix at COTA on October 25, 2026
- Antonelli started from pole position
- Winning margin: 13.078 seconds ahead of Charles Leclerc — described as "dominant victory"
- Podium: 1st Antonelli, 2nd Leclerc (Ferrari), 3rd Verstappen (Red Bull)
- Lewis Hamilton (Mercedes) finished 4th
- This was Antonelli's 9th win of the 2026 season
- Antonelli did NOT clinch the F1 world championship at COTA

article.headline: How Kimi Antonelli Clinches the F1 Title in Mexico — P9 Is All He Needs for Historic Record

research.facts:
Antonelli Clinch Math
**Verified Facts (HIGH):**
- After USGP: Antonelli leads championship by ~123-124 points over Russell and Hamilton
- Maximum points remaining across 5 races: 125 points
- Clinch condition: Antonelli needs P9 or better at Mexico City GP (November 1) to secure the title
- Antonelli ~20 years old
- Sebastian Vettel's youngest champion record: 23 years, 134 days (set at 2010 Japanese GP)
- Antonelli would become youngest F1 world champion in history if he clinches
- Pre-Austin: Antonelli led Russell by 102 points; after winning USGP (+25 pts) → lead grows to ~127 points
research.sources:
- Source: multiple sources including motorsportmagazine.com, f1oversteer.com, racingnews365.com, Yahoo Sports
**Confidence:** HIGH (clinch math confirmed by multiple pre/post-race sources)
